claims.scope: For every Boolean h:{-1,1}^n->{-1,1}, in natural units, sum_i hat(h,{i})^2 log(1/hat(h,{i})^2) <= (2/e) I(h). For a balanced disjoint substitution F=g(h_1,...,h_m), the q_j-weighted sum of these explicit logarithmic coherent-remainder terms over one nonreusing physical layer is at most (2/e)I(F).
hypotheses: h is a genuine Boolean sign; balance is needed only to invoke the sourced composition interface
composition child blocks are physically disjoint
logarithms are natural; divide by ln(2) for bits

claims.scope: For the sourced coherent remainder, R(alpha)=0 if alpha=0, q=0, or a_T b_T=0 for every neighboring Fourier index T.
Bound the complete coherent remainder, including its non-logarithmic interference component, through an unbounded physical restriction hierarchy whose children become biased.
claims.exact_obstruction: The first-layer alpha-log term is paid, but no summable bound is proved for C_j(alpha), and the balanced-child identity is not restriction-closed.
